Регрессия чистая (ui 5/5, input+dev 5/5), `node_modules` под .gitignore. Публикую.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "taskId": "f82d8a74-92cf-42ff-822b-83e8ce041186",
  "commandId": "camera-smoothing-publish",
  "operation": "publish",
  "headSha": "77b38d1780726161f87e511138beae87cceeb098",
  "message": "Implement camera smoothing and transitions

Add a renderer-agnostic smoothing layer under src/camera:
- Easing: named curves plus resolveEasing with a safe fallback
- Smoothing: frame-rate independent damping, shortest-arc angle damping,
  critically damped springs (smoothDamp/smoothDampVec3) and a frame delta
  clamp so a stalled tab cannot teleport the camera
- CameraPose: position/target/fov pose with lerp and distance helpers
- CameraTransition: timed blend from a frozen start pose toward a live
  destination, interruptible and restartable without a jump
- SmoothCameraRig: springs + transitions + the existing collision resolver,
  handing transition momentum to the springs on completion
- ThreeCameraBinding: apply/read a pose on a THREE.PerspectiveCamera

Camera modes stay out of scope; the rig takes a desired pose per frame.
Covered by src/camera/CameraSmoothing.test.ts (23 tests) and a test:camera script."
}
```
